$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}((y + 1)\ln (x + 4)) \\  & =\frac{y + 1}{x + 4} \\ \frac{∂f}{∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}((y + 1)\ln (x + 4)) \\  & =\ln(x + 4)\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have

$$
\nabla f(x,y) = \dfrac {y + 1}{x + 4} \, \mathbf i + \ln(x + 4) \, \mathbf j.
$$

Now, we solve $\nabla f(x,y) = \mathbf 0\mathbin{:}$

$$
\dfrac {y + 1}{x + 4} \, \mathbf i + \ln(x + 4) \, \mathbf j = 0 \mathbf i + 0\mathbf j
$$

By equating the coefficients of $\mathbf{i}$ on both sides of the equation (and similarly with $\mathbf{j}$), we obtain

$$
\{\begin{aligned}\frac{y + 1}{x + 4}=0 \\ \ln(x + 4)=0.\end{aligned}
$$

From the first equation, we get $y + 1=0,$ which means $y=-1.$ From the second equation, we obtain $\ln(x + 4)=0,$ which means that $x=-3.$

Therefore, $\nabla f(x,y) =\mathbf 0$ at the point $(-3,-1).$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["32a3ba95-14d4-5176-8a6e-171c8d545d55"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "7ce4e93e-ebf7-5551-ab02-5b20e6f42b2b" :answer/id #uuid "7ce4e93e-ebf7-5551-ab02-5b20e6f42b2b" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "(-1,-1)" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "3d754153-fc36-5a9f-8e3a-712811db4818" :answer/id #uuid "3d754153-fc36-5a9f-8e3a-712811db4818" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "(-1,0)" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "afe9dc9d-2224-5c05-9bd1-ca3051880b20" :answer/id #uuid "afe9dc9d-2224-5c05-9bd1-ca3051880b20" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "(-3,1)" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "fb5daf4f-98be-5821-929f-7d6cc71f5edd" :answer/id #uuid "fb5daf4f-98be-5821-929f-7d6cc71f5edd" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "(-2,1)" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "7a04eb94-3e8f-5e34-a445-2669ab21c905" :answer/id #uuid "7a04eb94-3e8f-5e34-a445-2669ab21c905" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "(-1,1)" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "1c943c87-8a4d-5a5b-b6cb-7302a54e2cba" :answer-field/id #uuid "1c943c87-8a4d-5a5b-b6cb-7302a54e2cba" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["7ce4e93e-ebf7-5551-ab02-5b20e6f42b2b" "3d754153-fc36-5a9f-8e3a-712811db4818" "afe9dc9d-2224-5c05-9bd1-ca3051880b20" "fb5daf4f-98be-5821-929f-7d6cc71f5edd" "7a04eb94-3e8f-5e34-a445-2669ab21c905"] :answer-field/correct "7a04eb94-3e8f-5e34-a445-2669ab21c905" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "d1ec7812-3978-5a02-ac42-759b550f6d05" :question/id #uuid "d1ec7812-3978-5a02-ac42-759b550f6d05" :question/problem "Given that $f(x,y)= (y - 1)\ln (x + 2),$ find the points $(x, y)$ where $\nabla f(x,y) = \mathbf 0.$" :question/worked-solution "First, we find the partial derivatives:
